text: Loooks to be good. so now back to the hang
resolution: Returned to the /workbench hang and fixed the remaining measured host-flush path by moving first-use Scene3D vertex payloads off JSON arrays. Added __hostUploadFloatBuffer in framework/v8_bindings_core.zig, a one-shot content-store take path in v8_app.zig for scene3dVerticesHandle, and runtime/primitives.tsx now sends typed-array handles for first registration of static/dynamic Scene3D geometry while preserving the old JSON array fallback. This targets the cold workbench character mount's vertex-buffer stringify/parse/copy cost; tools/rjit game verify hmsc-int is green. Live confirmation is still needed because native host changes require a dev-host restart/rebuild, not just JS hot reload.
